versions.changelog:
Initial release – provides a structured data toolkit for Xiaohongshu (RED) content analysis and monitoring.

- Supports search by keyword, note details with comments, creator post lists, and comment extraction.
- No need for login; securely fetches public data (no risk of account lockout).
- Handles up to 10,000 items per request with flexible filtering (type, sort, time, quantity).
- Command-line usage via Node.js; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- Includes robust input validation and clear error handling.
